name: api-fastapi
title: API with FastAPI
description: A Python API with FastAPI, its own virtual environment and tests with pytest. Automatic OpenAPI docs.
author: Marlon Chaviano

verify.command: .venv/bin/python -c "import importlib, pkgutil, app; [importlib.import_module(f'app.{m.name}') for m in pkgutil.iter_modules(app.__path__)]" && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && (test ! -x .venv/bin/ruff || .venv/bin/ruff check .)

instructions:
## How to work here

- Activate the environment with `source .venv/bin/activate`. Start with `fastapi dev app/main.py` (docs at `/docs`).
- Group routes by resource with `APIRouter` in `app/routers/` and include them in `app/main.py`.
- Validate inputs and outputs with Pydantic models; type-annotate every function.
- After installing a package with pip, update `requirements.txt` (`pip freeze > requirements.txt`).
- Before finishing a task: `python -m pytest`.
